parsed.summary: The patch correctly addresses the issue of zero-padding for the Y specifier in DateFormat, but it lacks tests to ensure the fix works as expected.

issues.description: The patch does not include any tests to verify that the Y specifier now correctly returns a four-digit year padded with zeros.
